notes.title: The Man in the Fields - Update 1.2
notes.content:
Version 1.2

Hello again.
Halloween is here, so we have a new scary update for you. This update makes the game less difficult, better looking and of course, adds new content.

What’s new?

- New location: Lakeside
- New AI system for The Herald
- Added a new jumpscare for The Herald
- Added new particle effects
- Added new audio effects
- Added new light sources around the locations
- Added new random events

General Fixes:

- Reduced the balance penalty from 75% to 50% when the player gets caught
- Reduced the attack distance of The Herald
- Performance optimizations
- Added more time to the watch
- Improved visual effects
- Improved the interior of the locations
- UI improvements

Bug Fixes:

- Fixed a bug where the quality settings wouldn’t be saved correctly


Thank you once again for your continuous support and feedback. Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Update 1.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone. Here are the patch notes for a minor update 1.1.1:

- Changed the instructions to make the purpose of the safe room more clear
- The Herald can no longer enter the safe room at all
- Fixed the toilet that wouldn’t open in Mansion
- Fixed the cabinet door that wouldn’t open correctly
- Updated the Windows icon

notes.title: The Man in the Fields - Update 1.1
notes.content:
Version 1.1

Hello everyone.
The Man in the Fields has now been out for 4 days. Thank you for supporting the game and giving feedback to us. We have now fixed some common problems that some of you have encountered, plus added something new.


What's new?

- Added Xbox controller support
- Added new audio clips for The Herald
- Made house layouts noticeably smaller

General Fixes:

- Added more time to the watch
- Made the instructions more detailed
- Made the windows’ hitboxes smaller

Bug Fixes:

- Fixed some minor lighting & texture bugs


We cooked this update for you FAST. Thank you once again for playing and giving suggestions and feedback. This way we can make the game more entertaining for all of you. There will be even more updates in the future, so stay tuned.
